venues.name: Fillmore Auditorium (Denver)

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Fillmore Auditorium Box Office Hours are: Fridays 12PM-6PM 3 Hours before doors open on event days though show time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The box office accepts MasterCard, Visa, Amx, Discover. We have gone cashless at our box office window.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available on the evening of the show only approximately 30 minutes prior to the doors opening.

venues.parkingDetail: Street parking & paid lots. Arrive Early. Paid lots not affiliated with Fillmore.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an all general admission event unless otherwise noted on the map. We are offering accessible seating that you may purchase in advance for GA shows. Please be aware that stairs may restrict access to locations not marked as wheelchair accessible. ADA sections provide general admission entry to the purchased section, and seats in that section will be filled in order of arrival. A member of our team will be available to escort you to your seat once you arrive at the venue. If you do not see available accessible seats, please purchase a general admission ticket, and contact the venue so we may accommodate your request for accessible seating. We recommend that you arrive at the venue at the door time listed on the event page and talk to a member of our staff to receive accommodations.

generalInfo.generalRule: To enhance the guest experience and for your safety, the following items are prohibited from entry to the Fillmore: Cans, bottles, glass, outside food or drinks, large bags or backpacks, weapons of any kind, illegal drugs, laser pointers, video recorders, large or professional cameras, stickers, flyers, markers, glow sticks, projectiles. The Fillmore Auditorium is a no smoking facility, cigarettes and any other inhaling devices including vaporizers are prohibited inside the venue. Tobacco products may be consumed in our designated smoking area outside the South side of the venue. Marijuana products are prohibited. Per Colorado Amendment 64, public display and consumption of marijuana is prohibited by law. Crowd surfing and other behavior that may endanger the well-being of other patrons is prohibited. Small cameras and audio recording subject to artist approval. Other items may be prohibited at artist request or venue discretion. The Fillmore reserves the right to refuse entry or remove anyone for any reason. Most shows are ages 16 & over with valid ID only unless otherwise noted. Alcohol will be served to those who are 21+ with valid I.D. There are some shows that are listed as *All Ages* where there will be no age requirement for entrance. The Fillmore Auditorium is usually configured as General Admission mainly standing-room with limited seating areas available.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Calls are answered 11am to 6pm Monday through Friday as well as during regular box office hours Box Office Hours: 12 to 5pm on Fridays (at Summit Box Office) and 1 hour before doors open on show days
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: o Ticketmaster will call opens one hour prior to doors or at the scheduled meet and greet check-in time. Artist guest list may not arrive until doors time. Remember to bring your photo ID and the credit card used to purchase your tickets! Tickets are not transferable. The original ticket purchaser must go back to the original point of purchase to make the change. If you are a radio contest winner, guest of someone in the band, or a VIP client, please touch base with your original point of contact and they will get in touch with us to make any changes on your behalf.

venues.parkingDetail: There are several pay parking lots located around the venue (costs will vary). Street parking is also available, but please note that parking meters have a 2-hour limit. Close proximity to public transportation and Union Station. Summit has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer easy and reliable parking options. Book Parking Here - https://www.parkwhiz.com/summit-music-hall-parking
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: o Summit strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible. Please visit summitdenver.com/accessibility to learn more. For more questions, don't hesitate to get in touch with us at 303-487-0111 or SummitDenver@LiveNation.com

generalInfo.generalRule: A valid ID is required to attend any age restricted events and to consume alcohol. Accepted forms of identification include state-issued ID or Drivers License, valid non-expired US Government or Military ID, or an official passport. Summit has a very strict underage drinking policy that follows state law, and if you do not have acceptable ID that states your age at 21 or older, you will be considered the same as a minor and will not be able to purchase, consume or possess alcohol in the venue. Violators will be removed from the building without warnings and will not be eligible for a refund. Age requirements differ depending on the event. All age requirements are listed directly on the event page. If no age restriction is listed, the event is all ages. Customer Safety information and restricted items list available here https://www.livenation.com/venueguidelines Reentry is not permitted at our venue. Make sure you do not leave the venue unless you do not plan on coming back! Summit is a completely nonsmoking venue. Smoking is only allowed in designated outdoor smoking areas. Most events only offer General Admission standing and seating, which are first come, first serve. Please refer to the event page for seating options by event.
